source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Είκοσιεπτά Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and the whole of it is one sentence: «Οι Άγιοι αυτοί Μάρτυρες μαρτύρησαν δια πυρός» — these holy martyrs were martyred by fire. **This is a company that names nobody, so it is one folder and not twenty-seven**, which is `CORPUS.md` §10.1's test read the other way from the enumerated family of 2 Μαΐου: there the page gave four head lines and four years, and here it gives none. The corpus already holds four such unnamed companies of this shape — `six-martyrs-21-september`, `six-martyrs-of-melitene`, `six-martyrs-of-phrygia`, `four-martyrs-of-perge` — and this folder follows their form, including `sex: unknown` and a `names` form kept whole rather than stripped. No place, no year, no emperor, no hymn, no relic.
